messages.subject: createModels(): Set 'nobservations' for multilevel analyses
parts:
Hello,

I am trying to generate inp.-files for montecarlo analyses of two-level and three-level models with varying sample sizes. The Mplus input-file requires the specification of the number of clusters, the cluster sizes, and the resulting number of observations. If I iterate the number of clusters and cluster sizes, the number of observations needs to change accordingly. Unfortunately, I cannot figure out a smart way to automatically set the correct value for the nobservations line. An example for the text-file would be:

[[init]]
iterators = n2 n3;
n2 = 5 15 35;
n3 = 10 20 50;
nobs = n2*n3; ! this does not work
filename = "n2[[n2]]n3[[n3]].inp";
outputDirectory = ...;
[[/init]]
  TITLE: Title
  MONTECARLO:
   NAMES ARE y;
   NREPS = 10;
   SEED = 58459;
   nobservations = [[nobs]]; ! should be n2*n3
   ncsizes = 1;
   csizes = [[n3]] ([[n2]]);
   REPSAVE = ALL;
   SAVE = rep*.dat;
ANALYSIS: TYPE = twolevel random;
…

Is there a way to calculate and insert the correct value (e.g.: nobservations=50; for n2=5 and n3=10)? I assume I could generate the .inp-files and then replace the placeholder, e.g. 'nobs', with the correct value in a second step via R. I could also use nested conditional tags, but these options seem to be quite inefficient. 

Do you have any advice?

Best,

Denise
